seoDescription: Read Orary's Terms of Service. Understand your rights and responsibilities when using our shift management and earnings tracking application.
title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to Orary. By downloading, accessing, or using this application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you disagree with any part of these terms, you must not access our service.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
blocks: These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and Orary. We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

sections.title: 2. Description of Service
blocks: Orary is a digital tool designed to help workers track their shifts, calculate earnings based on configurable rates, and visualize their work statistics. The service is provided "as is" and is intended for personal organizational purposes.

warn.title: Important Disclaimer About Calculations
items: All earnings calculations displayed in Orary are estimates based on the rates and preferences you configure within the application.
Your actual paycheck may include additional values not tracked by this application, such as bonuses, penalties, superannuation contributions, tax withholdings, or other payroll adjustments.
The values shown are not official and should not be used as legal or tax documents.
Always verify your actual earnings with your official payslips and employer records.
Figures extracted automatically from uploaded payslips may contain reading errors. Always check them against the original document.
The Working Holiday Visa day count is an estimate based on the shifts you record. Only the immigration authority decides which days count towards your visa. Keep your payslips and employer evidence.

Income tax and refund estimates are approximations based on published income tax brackets only. They do not include levies (e.g. Medicare, ACC), National Insurance, USC, PRSI, offsets, or your personal circumstances, and are not tax advice. Always confirm with your official tax office or a registered tax agent before lodging.
Orary is not responsible for any discrepancies between the estimated values and your actual received payment.

sections.title: 3. User Responsibilities
blocks: As a user of Orary, you agree to:

ul: Provide accurate and current information when creating your account.
Maintain the security of your password and account.
Accept full responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.
Not use the application for any illegal purpose or to harass other users.
Understand that calculations provided by the app are estimates based on user input and should not be used as official legal or tax documents without verification.
Configure your hourly rates, shift types, and deductions accurately to obtain the most precise estimates.

sections.title: 4. Location Data
blocks: Orary may request access to your device's location (via the browser Geolocation API) solely to enable relevant regional features, such as:

ul: Auto-detecting your country to activate the Working Holiday Visa 88-day tracker (Australia) or configure public holiday calendars.
Setting your regional preferences within the app.

blocks: Location data is processed locally on your device. Only the resulting country preference is saved to your account. We do not store your precise GPS coordinates or transmit them to our servers. You may deny location access at any time without affecting other app functionality.

No charges will be made to your payment method during the trial period.

At the end of the 15-day trial, your subscription automatically converts to a paid subscription and your payment method will be charged $2.99 AUD (or equivalent in your local currency).
If you cancel before the trial ends, you will continue to have Premium access until the end of the trial period, and no charges will be made.
We reserve the right to modify or terminate the free trial offer at any time.
After the trial period (or immediately if no trial applies), you agree to pay the recurring subscription fee ($2.99 AUD/month).
